name: archisys-mcp
description: Archisys as an MCP server: an AI assistant builds a system design, runs it through a real discrete-event simulation, and shows it on a live canvas

scripts.build: vite build && tsx scripts/readme.ts && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --loader:.md=text --loader:.html=text
